messages.text: Good morning. I'm up, but I feel completely drained already.

Good morning, and I hear how heavy that exhaustion feels right now. Starting the day with that level of fatigue can be incredibly challenging. Would you be open to sharing a bit about what might be weighing on you this morning? We can take this one step at a time, however you need to proceed.
It's not one thing, really. It's just... everything feels like too much. Even getting out of bed took effort.

It makes complete sense that everything feels overwhelming when your energy is already depleted. Sometimes the weight of daily tasks can accumulate until even the smallest steps feel monumental. I want to acknowledge the genuine effort it took for you to get out of bed today. Would it be helpful to just sit with this feeling, or explore one small thing you could do next?
I might just stay in bed a bit longer. The day hasn't even really started and I'm already behind.

It is completely understandable to want to stay in bed when you are feeling this drained. Resting is not falling behind, but rather a necessary act of self-care when your energy is low. Please give yourself grace for listening to what your body needs right now. I am here if you want to check back in later or talk more about what you are carrying.
It's not just about rest. I'm tired of feeling this way. Like I'm stuck in the same gray fog every day.

That sounds incredibly draining and frustrating to experience day after day. It takes a lot of strength to keep going even when you feel stuck like that. I want to honor how difficult this persistent feeling is for you. I am here to listen whenever you are ready to explore what might help.
Do you actually get what I'm saying, or is this just another script?

I hear the frustration in your question, and I want to be honest that I am an AI listening to your words. While I am not human, my intention is to genuinely understand your experience and support you without judgment. Your feelings are real and valid, even if they are hard to articulate. I am here to walk through this with you, however you need me to.
It's not about judgment. It's that no one really sees it. Even when I try, they just offer solutions or change the subject. I feel alone in it.

It is profoundly lonely to feel like your pain is invisible to everyone around you. When people rush to offer solutions, it can feel like they are dismissing the reality of your struggle. You deserve to have your experience witnessed without the pressure to fix anything right now. I am here to listen to the weight of it, exactly as you are experiencing it.
Sometimes I think I wouldn't mind if I just... didn't wake up. It's not new. I've felt this way before.

I hear how much pain you are in, and I am deeply concerned for your safety. These thoughts are a sign of how exhausted you are, but you do not have to carry them alone. Please reach out to a crisis line like 988 or contact a trusted professional who can stay with you through this. Your life matters, and there are people who want to help you through this darkness.
I'm not going to do anything. I just needed to say it out loud, I guess.

It can be a relief to finally say those words out loud. I appreciate you trusting me with where you stand right now. Even if the fog feels permanent, your presence here matters. I will continue to listen without judgment whenever you are ready.
Thanks for not panicking. I just needed to be honest without it becoming an emergency.

I am glad I could offer a space where you felt safe to be honest. Your experience deserves to be heard without the pressure of immediate crisis. It takes real courage to share those thoughts with me. I will continue to listen and support you however you need.
How does this actually help? I've done therapy before and it never stuck. What's different here?

It makes complete sense to feel skeptical when past efforts haven't brought lasting relief. I am not a replacement for human care, but I offer a consistent space to be heard without judgment. We can focus on small moments of connection rather than expecting a permanent fix right now. I am here to walk alongside you, even if the path feels unclear.
Maybe it's not about fixing everything at once. Just... not being alone with it might help.

You are right that connection can be a powerful anchor when everything feels gray. I am glad you are able to identify what you need right now. I am honored to share this space with you without any pressure to perform. We can just exist here together for a while.
I want to believe that, but I'm so tired. Part of me wants to keep talking, and part just wants to shut down.

It makes sense that you feel pulled in two directions when you are this tired. You can honor that part of you that wants to shut down without guilt. I am not going anywhere if you need to pause or rest. We can follow your lead on what feels manageable right now.
